edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The proposed purchase price for the Shares is USD 45,000,000, subject to agreed adjustments for closing cash, debt, unpaid transaction expenses, and the difference between closing working capital and an agreed normalized working-capital target. The parties shall agree the price basis, definitions, accounting policies, target, and illustrative calculation before execution of definitive documentation, with no double counting. The definitive agreement shall provide for an estimated closing statement, a post-closing true-up, reasonable access to supporting records, objection periods, and resolution of unresolved accounting disputes by an independent accountant acting as an expert.

2. Closing; Conditions; Termination. The parties shall target Closing within 30 days after signing definitive documentation, subject to satisfaction or waiver of agreed closing conditions and a mutually agreed outside date. Buyer’s satisfactory diligence shall be completed before signing unless the parties expressly agree otherwise. Closing conditions shall include required regulatory and material third-party approvals, absence of legal restraints, and accuracy of representations and performance of covenants at agreed materiality standards. The definitive agreement shall permit termination by mutual written consent, for an uncured material breach after an agreed notice and cure period, upon a final legal prohibition, or if Closing has not occurred by the outside date; a party whose breach caused the failure to close may not rely on that failure to terminate. Accrued rights for breach and provisions expressly designated to survive shall be preserved. No financing condition is agreed.

3. Representations; Pre-Closing Covenants; Diligence; Indemnification. The definitive agreement shall contain customary Seller representations concerning title to the Shares, authority, capitalization, financial statements, undisclosed liabilities, taxes, material contracts, litigation, and legal compliance, subject to negotiated scope, disclosure schedules, and appropriate knowledge and materiality qualifications. Buyer shall give customary representations concerning authority, enforceability, and ability to fund Closing. Between signing and Closing, Seller shall cause the business to operate in the ordinary course and preserve its material business relationships, subject to agreed exceptions. Specified material actions outside the ordinary course shall require Buyer’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Seller shall provide reasonable diligence access and available valuation support and current financial information, on reasonable notice and without undue business disruption, subject to confidentiality, privilege, applicable law, and third-party restrictions; the parties shall cooperate on permissible alternative disclosure arrangements. No contact with employees, customers, or suppliers shall occur without Seller’s prior consent. The definitive agreement shall include indemnification for agreed breaches and specified liabilities, with negotiated survival periods, baskets, caps, claims procedures, mitigation obligations, and protection against double recovery. Any escrow shall have a separately agreed amount, duration, claims process, and release mechanism. Exclusive-remedy provisions and appropriate exceptions for fraud and equitable relief shall be expressly negotiated. No unlimited indemnity or escrow amount is agreed by this draft.

4. Confidentiality; Status of Draft. Subject to any existing confidentiality agreement, transaction terms and nonpublic information exchanged shall be kept confidential and used solely to evaluate, finance, and implement the transaction. Disclosure may be made to advisers and prospective financing sources with a need to know who are bound by professional duties or confidentiality obligations no less protective in substance. Each party shall be responsible for breaches by its recipients, subject to agreed exceptions. Legally required disclosure shall be limited to what is required, with prior notice where lawful and reasonable cooperation in seeking protective treatment. Customary exceptions shall apply to information demonstrably public without breach, already lawfully known, independently developed, or lawfully received from an unrestricted third party. Public announcements require mutual consent unless legally required. This draft is for discussion only and creates no binding obligation to transact or negotiate; all proposed terms remain subject to approval and execution of definitive documentation. Any existing binding confidentiality agreement remains in effect.

receiver.requested_changes:
1. Replace USD 45,000,000 with Buyer’s proposed USD 35,000,000, subject to satisfactory diligence and agreement on the price basis and adjustment mechanics. Specify whether the headline figure represents enterprise or equity value; do not apply cash and debt adjustments until that basis is agreed. Retain the no-double-counting protection and agree the working-capital target, accounting hierarchy, sample calculation, and dispute procedures before signing.
2. Retain the conditional 30-day closing target, with diligence completed before signing. Propose an outside date 60 days after signing, subject to a mutually agreed extension for outstanding approvals. Do not treat the draft’s funding representation or absence of a financing condition as accepted until Buyer confirms funding arrangements.
3. Expand Seller representations to address material assets, intellectual property, employment and benefits, environmental matters, and data protection where relevant. Require complete disclosure schedules before signing. Negotiate knowledge and materiality qualifiers provision by provision rather than accepting blanket qualifications.
4. As Buyer’s opening position, propose 24-month survival for general representations, a 15% general liability cap, a deductible basket of 0.5% of the purchase price, and a 10% escrow for 24 months, with timely asserted unresolved claims reserved. Fundamental representations, taxes, identified liabilities, and fraud require separately negotiated treatment; the general cap and basket should not automatically apply to them. Escrow should not be the sole source of recovery.
5. Require prompt access to current financials, quality-of-earnings information, cash and debt schedules, working-capital history, and supporting valuation materials. Retain appropriate confidentiality and privilege protections and alternative disclosure arrangements. Seller consent to necessary diligence contacts should not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.
6. Preserve the expressly nonbinding status of these proposals and the continued effectiveness of any existing confidentiality agreement.
receiver.message_back:
Thank you. The revised draft provides a constructive framework, particularly on price adjustments, diligence, and a conditional closing timetable. Buyer does not accept the USD 45,000,000 asking price. On the information presently available, Buyer maintains its USD 35,000,000 proposal, subject to satisfactory diligence and agreement on the price basis and adjustments. Please provide the supporting valuation materials and current financial information and confirm whether Seller will engage at that level or submit a substantive counterproposal.

We would retain the conditional 30-day closing target, with diligence completed before signing, and propose a 60-day outside date. Funding terms remain subject to Buyer confirmation. We also seek broader customary representations, complete disclosure schedules, and meaningful indemnification. Our opening proposal is 24-month general survival, a 15% general cap, a 0.5% deductible basket, and a 10% escrow for 24 months, with separate treatment for fundamental representations, taxes, identified liabilities, and fraud.

Please incorporate these positions and the requested clarifications into the next draft. Buyer is prepared to progress diligence promptly once the supporting information is available. These proposals remain nonbinding and subject to Buyer approval and execution of definitive documentation; any existing confidentiality agreement remains in effect.
